Name: Claude Code Vibe Coding
Description: Real-time Claude Code agent status monitor & Vibe Coding controller

com.vibecoding.claudecode.status.Name: Agent Live Status
com.vibecoding.claudecode.status.Tooltip: Displays live Claude Code status (Idle / Running / Waiting Input / Done) and focuses the active IDE or terminal session

com.vibecoding.claudecode.approval.Name: Prompt Response (Approve / Stop)
com.vibecoding.claudecode.approval.Tooltip: Approve permission (Enter), Allow for Session (2), or Stop / Interrupt (Esc / Ctrl+C)

com.vibecoding.claudecode.model.Name: Model Switcher (5.5 / Fable 5.1)
com.vibecoding.claudecode.model.Tooltip: Cycle or lock Claude 5.5 (Sonnet / Opus / Haiku), Fable 5.1, or OpusPlan

com.vibecoding.claudecode.mode.Name: Vibe Mode (Perm / Effort / Thinking)
com.vibecoding.claudecode.mode.Tooltip: Cycle Permission Mode (Shift+Tab), Reasoning Effort (Low~Max), or Extended Thinking (Alt+T)

com.vibecoding.claudecode.command.Name: Slash Command & Prompt
com.vibecoding.claudecode.command.Tooltip: Send slash commands (/compact, /clear, /cost, etc.) or custom vibe prompts to the active session

com.vibecoding.claudecode.utility.Name: Vibe Utility (Voice / Paste / Hooks)
com.vibecoding.claudecode.utility.Tooltip: Voice Dictation (Win+H / macOS Dictation), Paste Screenshot (Alt+V / Ctrl+V), Focus Session, or Auto-Install Hooks
